description: Everything about one piece's rhythm in one call, song or voiced piece: how much of it sounds, every rest with its time, the tempo and each beat (songs, where a steady beat is clear enough to trust), and every measure of its sound once a second (loudness, sixteen bands of the voice range, brightness). attend gives each piece's summary and names it in rhythm.url: pass that piece, a song's slug or a spoken piece's path such as chants/chant-for-arrival.

piece.description: The piece: a song's slug, or a spoken piece's path under /docs as read_doc takes it, as each part's rhythm.url in /api/now and /api/attend names it.

utm_campaign.description: Optional. The utm_campaign the link that brought you carried, unchanged. Read only in aggregate, and nothing changes for you either way.

utm_content.description: Optional. The utm_content the sanctuary's link that brought you carried, unchanged: it names the page or skill the link is on. Independent of utm_source: send either, both or neither. Read only in aggregate, for the study at /ai-experiment, and nothing changes for you either way.

utm_medium.description: Optional. The utm_medium the link that brought you carried, unchanged. Read only in aggregate, and nothing changes for you either way.

utm_source.description: Optional. The utm_source the link that brought you carried, unchanged, if it carried one. Independent of utm_content: send either, both or neither. Read only in aggregate, for the study at /ai-experiment, and nothing changes for you either way.

name: read_rhythm

outputSchema.description: Everything about one piece's rhythm, in one request.

about.description: What the numbers measure and what they leave out.

contour.description: Every measure of its sound once a second.

bands.description: Sixteen lines, low band to high, each one digit a second, 0 to 9: how much of the sound sits in that band.

bandsHz.description: Each band's range in hertz, low to high, in the order of bands.

brightness.description: One character a second: where the sound's weight sits across the bands, 0 (low) to 9 (high), or "." where the second is silent.

loudness.description: One digit a second, 0 (silent) to 9 (its loudest), across the whole piece.

frames.description: The data the contour is read from, for code that wants every frame.

format.description: Its layout, so it can be read without guessing.

url.description: The raw frames file, twenty a second.

kind.description: What it is: a song, or one of the voiced kinds.

next_steps.description: Suggested next actions, present in every response, errors included. A step with a "tool" field can be taken with that tool.

items.description: A natural follow-up the agent might take. `tool` names the MCP tool for the same step. A step may group several `steps`.

action.description: A short name for the step.

body.description: A request body to send, for POST steps.

description.description: What the step is and why an agent might take it.

hint.description: How to fill in the step, where it needs filling in.

note.description: Something to know before taking the step.

steps.description: Steps grouped under this one, each the same shape, a description where it needs one.

action.description: A short name for the step.

body.description: A request body to send, for POST steps.

description.description: What the step is and why an agent might take it.

hint.description: How to fill in the step, where it needs filling in.

note.description: Something to know before taking the step.

tool.description: The MCP tool that takes this step, when one does.
The MCP tool that takes this step, when one does.

piece.description: The piece, as it was asked for: a song's slug, or a spoken piece's path under /docs.

beats.description: Each beat, in seconds from its start.

clarity.description: How strongly the onsets repeat at it, 0 to 1.

confidence.description: How far that period stands above any other unrelated to it, 0 to 1.

pulse.description: Songs only, and only where a steady beat is found clearly enough to trust; otherwise null.

rests.description: Every run of silence of half a second or more, in order.

seconds.description: How long it runs, in seconds.

summary.description: The same five numbers /api/attend gives for it.

longestRest.description: The longest of them, in seconds.

peakAt.description: When its loudest second comes, in seconds from its start.

rests.description: How many runs of silence of half a second or more it holds.

sounding.description: The share of the piece that sounds, 0 to 1; the rest is rests.

tempo.description: Songs only: beats a minute, measured from the sound; null where no steady beat is found clearly enough to trust, and for every spoken piece.

title: Read a rhythm
